vte_events.poolable_reason: k=1, AND THE SECOND TRIAL BELONGS TO A DIFFERENT DRUG. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18. NCT01857583 tests DU-176b (edoxaban) at three doses, ALL typed EXPERIMENTAL, against fondaparinux as its ACTIVE_COMPARATOR -- so it is an edoxaban trial and fondaparinux appears in it only as the control. That is the OLMESARTAN shape and it is real here for that one trial. NCT00789399 IS a genuine fondaparinux trial: its own title reads 'A Study of the Efficacy of Preventive Dosing of Fondaparinux Sodium Versus Placebo' and its other arm is typed PLACEBO_COMPARATOR, so fondaparinux is unambiguously the tested agent even though its arm is typed ACTIVE_COMPARATOR. SO THIS TOPIC IS NOT COMPARATOR-SHAPED -- it does contain a fondaparinux trial -- but it contains exactly one, and a single trial is reported as a single trial.

vte_events.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the contributing trial is poor -- it is registered, randomised and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that this page holds one trial that answers the question its title asks.
vte_events.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
vte_events.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades the trials contributing to a pooled result, and this page publishes none.
